newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr recovers in early Tokyo after panic sales.
newsitem.headline: Dlr recovers in early Tokyo after panic sales.

text.p: *Dollar recovered on short-covering by interbank traders after diving against yen in early Asian trading.
*Dollar was quoted at 118.68/78 yen at 2346 GMT.
*Panic sales by life and non-life insurance companies emerged to knock dollar down to around 117.60 yen in early Asian trade from New York close of 120.20/30 yen on Friday.
*Those insurers were selling dollars in forward contracts to hedge against rising foreign exchange losses on foreign bond holdings. *Japanese exporters were sidelined so far, but may emerge later.
